# MyIdeApp

> Independent studio publishing privacy-first iOS apps. Data stays on the device whenever possible; no social feeds. Free to download, optional subscription. Site: https://myideapp.com/

## Apps

### Rhythm - Period & Cycle
Ovulation, fertility & moods. Rhythm helps you understand your menstrual cycle on your own terms — without judgment, without shame.
- Page: https://myideapp.com/rhythm/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/rhythm-cycle-wellbeing/id6767194298
- Key features: Know your cycle; Log what matters; Medication reminders; Apple health; Home screen widget; Calendar sync; Insights; Privacy first
- Privacy policy: https://myideapp.com/rhythm/privacy.html

### RunFree - Run Tracker & GPS
Private jogging & pace log. Run more. Stress less. Own your data.
- Page: https://myideapp.com/runfree/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/runfree-courez-lessentiel/id6772151593
- Key features: GPS run tracking; Full run history; 5 run types; 1 built-in training plan; Personal records; Training calendar; 4 training plans; Custom plan builder
- Privacy policy: https://myideapp.com/runfree/privacy.html

### MyFoodBook - Recipe Keeper
Recipes & shopping list. MyFoodBook is your personal recipe keeper — simple, warm and free to use.
- Page: https://myideapp.com/myfoodbook/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/myfoodbook-recipe-keeper/id6785071500
- Key features: Why you'll love it; Free to use; Works offline; Organize with tags; Mark your favorites and search instantly; Light and dark mode; Available in 9 languages; Private by design
- Privacy policy: https://myideapp.com/myfoodbook/privacy.html

### HydroMe - Water Tracker
Daily Drink Reminder. HydroMe is a minimalist hydration tracker built around one simple idea: staying hydrated should be effortless.
- Page: https://myideapp.com/hydrome/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/hydrome-suivi-hydratation/id6774221997
- Key features: Beautiful animated progress ring; Daily goal with streak counter; Weekly history view; Up to 3 daily reminders; Metric (ml) and imperial (oz) units; 9 languages supported; Privacy Policy; Support
- Privacy policy: https://myideapp.com/hydrome/privacy.html

### StockWatch - Stocks & Alerts
Stocks, portfolio & alerts. StockWatch is the simple, educational way to follow the stock market — without risking a cent.
- Page: https://myideapp.com/stockwatch/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/stockwatch-stocks-alerts/id6785483739
- Key features: What you can do; Virtual portfolio; Price alerts (you set the threshold); Market overview; DCA simulator to learn dollar-cost averaging; Learn; Market news; Privacy first
- Privacy policy: https://myideapp.com/stockwatch/privacy.html

### Chapter - Dating Journal
Remember every match & date. Never mix up the people you're dating again.

### LunaRest - Sleep Sounds
White noise, tracker & alarm. LunaRest is the sleep app that adapts to YOUR internal clock — not a one-size-fits-all routine. Discover your chronotype, and LunaRest tunes your whole night around it.
- Page: https://myideapp.com/lunarest/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/lunarest-sleep-sounds/id6762608744

- Privacy policy: https://myideapp.com/budgetbrief/privacy.html
